description: Aider-polyglot style (Python), built for the repair round: format whole numbers as English ordinals. The natural first implementation picks the suffix from the last digit alone and so writes 11st, 12nd, 13rd, 111st and 1012nd; the instructions state the 11/12/13 exception (judged on the last two digits) and the tests catch it, so the post-turn verifier's second round has to fix it. Also checks the bool-is-not-an-int rule and the error types.
